title: LlmJudgeOutputV2
description: Output of prompt judge from version 6 (SPEC 7.3). Schema version 1.2.0: the 1.1.0 answer (llm_judge_output.schema.json, kept for judge versions 3 to 5) plus three fields on the quote (#639 7115208555): certainty, experiencer and time. A note exclusion stands only when both models give affirmed, patient and current; any other value, or null, sends the patient to review. Every property is required so strict structured output accepts the schema; null means absent. The three fields come before reason, and reason before confidence, the order a guided decoder writes them (1.1.0's note).

certainty.description: What the quote says of the condition: affirmed (stated present), negated (stated absent), possible (suspected, a question, to rule out), unknown (unknown or pending: a test ordered, a result awaited).

experiencer.description: Whose condition the quote states: the patient's, or another person's (a relative, a partner, a contact).

time.description: When the quote places the condition: current (now, or ongoing), past_resolved (cured, resolved, treated and gone), planned (a test or a treatment to come, a prevention).
